question: Indian men's hockey team won bronze medal by defeating which country in Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympics in August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Germany**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian men's hockey team defeated Germany to win their first-ever Olympic medal in 41 years.
 
• It was India's third hockey bronze medal in the history of the Olympics. 
 
• The other two came in 1968 Mexico City and the 1972 Munich Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey**:

 
 
• The Hockey World cup is organised by the** International Hockey Federation (FIH)** once in four years.
 
• The headquarters of FIH is located in** Lausanne, Switzerland.**
 
• ‘Blackheath Rugby and Hockey Club’ was the first hockey club in the world that was set up in the year **1861 **in England.
 
• The first Hockey World Cup was organised in** Barcelona (Spain) in 1971** and the** winner was Pakistan.**
 
• India took part in Olympics for the first time in the year **1928 **(in Amsterdam Olympics).
 
• In Olympics,** India has won the hockey title a maximum of eight times.**
